headline.purpose: The page title, one per screen, in Bricolage at 92% width. On a detail page the name is 1.75rem and wraps rather than truncating, because a cultivar name is allowed to be long.

count.purpose: The day count in a propagation row's tile, and 2.25rem in the tile on a propagation page. Bricolage at 80% width with tabular figures, so three digits still fit.

title.purpose: Card headings and form fieldset legends, in Bricolage.

name.purpose: The name on a list row, in Bricolage.

body.purpose: Everything read as prose, in the system font. Notes preserve their line breaks.

label.purpose: The section marker: uppercase, 0.03em tracking, Muted Ink. Groupings on Today, stage groups, subheadings in a detail card, timeline date headings.

caption.purpose: Supporting lines. The species line under a plant name is set in italic here.

meta.purpose: The small line on a list row, timeline entry heads and the day on an activity line. The smallest size anything is read at.

micro.purpose: Only for words under something bigger that are never read on their own, like the tab labels in the bottom bar and "days" under a day count.

shadows.name: floating-action
shadows.purpose: The round add button, which hovers over scrolling content.

shadows.name: anchored-bar
shadows.purpose: Bars pinned above the bottom navigation, like the update banner and the bulk action bar, and the tour card. Points upward because the bar sits below the content it covers.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Every focused input and control. A state rather than elevation, and never to be removed. Uses the primary green, so it follows the dark theme's lighter green.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: Things that settle: a pressed list row springing back, the active tab's pill, the side menu's rows.

motion.name: state-fast
motion.purpose: Border and background changes on hover and focus: list rows, Settings rows.

motion.name: press-scale
motion.purpose: A list row while pressed, over 0.2s with ease-out-expo.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Every movement (bars growing in, the moment card's leaf, the tour card, the year deck) drops out. Colour changes may stay.

breakpoints.name: hero
breakpoints.purpose: The detail hero stops bleeding to the screen edges and takes a radius.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: The one width where the layout changes: the tabs become a 14rem side menu, the header goes, the gutter grows to 2rem, and pages that ask for it widen to 72rem or the full width.

breakpoints.name: wider
breakpoints.purpose: Lists get a filter column, Today gets its side column, and the plant and propagation forms split in two.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The committing action on a screen: save, add, promote. One per screen, so solid green keeps its meaning.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); color: #fff; font: 600 1rem/1.5 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); border-radius: 0.6rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, border-color 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--pa-green-dark, #1f5a37); border-color: var(--pa-green-dark, #1f5a37); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgb(47 125 79 / 0.25); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.45; cursor: default; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: The secondary action beside a primary one, and the default for a row of equal choices.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: transparent; color: var(--pa-green-dark, #1f5a37); font: 600 1rem/1.5 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); border-radius: 0.6rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-in-out, color 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:active { background: var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); color: #fff; } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgb(47 125 79 / 0.25); }

components.name: Floating Add Button
components.description: The round add button, fixed above the bottom navigation on list screens so it is always in reach of a thumb. On a wide screen it becomes a labelled button next to the title.
components.html: <button class="ds-fab" aria-label="Add plant"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14"/><path d="M5 12h14"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-fab { width: 3.5rem; height: 3.5rem; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); color: #fff; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-fab:hover { background: var(--pa-green-dark, #1f5a37); } .ds-fab:focus-visible { outline: none; background: var(--pa-green-dark, #1f5a37); box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.25), 0 0 0 0.2rem rgb(47 125 79 / 0.25); } .ds-fab svg { width: 1.6rem; height: 1.6rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 2.25; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A form field. Filled with the card colour rather than the page colour so it does not read as disabled. Focus turns the edge green and adds the focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; background: var(--pa-surface, #fff); color: var(--pa-text, #1d2520); font: 400 1rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; border: 1px solid var(--pa-border, #dde3dc); border-radius: 0.6rem; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-in-out, box-shadow 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--pa-muted, #5f6b63); opacity: 0.8; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgb(47 125 79 / 0.25); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: A choice in a row of pills: rooms, tags, pots without a photo. The picked one is Leaf Tint with a green edge, and a dashed chip adds a new name.
components.css: .ds-chip-row { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-chip { min-height: 2.25rem; padding: 0.3rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--pa-border, #dde3dc); border-radius: 999px; background: var(--pa-surface, #fff); color: var(--pa-text, #1d2520); font: 400 0.9rem/1.3 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgb(47 125 79 / 0.25); } .ds-chip.picked { border-color: var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); background: var(--pa-green-soft, #e6f2ea); color: var(--pa-green-dark, #1f5a37); font-weight: 600; } .ds-chip.new { border-style: dashed; color: var(--pa-muted, #5f6b63); }

components.name: Segmented Control
components.description: Radio buttons as equal-width segments, for filters and the kind of pot. The picked segment looks like a picked chip, so solid green stays for the main button on a screen.
components.css: .ds-segmented { display: flex; } .ds-segmented button { flex: 1; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.5rem; border: 1px solid var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); margin-left: -1px; background: transparent; color: var(--pa-green-dark, #1f5a37); font: 400 0.875rem/1 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-in-out; } .ds-segmented button:first-child { margin-left: 0; border-radius: 0.6rem 0 0 0.6rem; } .ds-segmented button:last-child { border-radius: 0 0.6rem 0.6rem 0; } .ds-segmented button:hover, .ds-segmented button.picked { background: var(--pa-green-soft, #e6f2ea); } .ds-segmented button.picked { font-weight: 600; } .ds-segmented button:focus-visible { outline: none; position: relative; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgb(47 125 79 / 0.25); }

components.name: Stage Badge
components.description: A propagation's stage in a Leaf Tint badge, led by three ticks filled up to the stage.
components.css: .ds-stage-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.4em; padding: 0.35em 0.65em; border-radius: 0.6rem; background: var(--pa-green-soft, #e6f2ea); color: var(--pa-green-dark, #1f5a37); font: 600 0.75rem/1 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-stage-steps { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; } .ds-stage-steps i { width: 0.3rem; height: 0.65rem; border-radius: 1px; background: var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); opacity: 0.25; } .ds-stage-steps[data-step='1'] i:nth-child(-n+1), .ds-stage-steps[data-step='2'] i:nth-child(-n+2), .ds-stage-steps[data-step='3'] i { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: The tabs along the bottom on a phone: a stroked icon over a Bricolage label. The active tab is Deep Moss at 600, and its icon sits on a Leaf Tint pill so where you are shows before you read. Pests only has a tab while a case or problem is open. From 64rem the same links stand in a menu down the left side.
components.html: TodayPlantsPropsPestsSupplies

components.name: List Row
components.description: The signature component. One plant or propagation in a list: a 3.5rem tile, the name, an italic species line and a meta line. A plant's tile is Clay, a propagation's is green, and every line truncates so row height never varies. A favourite's star is filled Clay.

components.css: .ds-item-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.85rem; padding: 0.7rem; background: var(--pa-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--pa-border, #dde3dc); border-radius: 0.75rem; color: var(--pa-text, #1d2520); text-decoration: none; font: 400 1rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; transition: border-color 0.15s ease-out, transform 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-item-card:hover { border-color: var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); } .ds-item-card:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgb(47 125 79 / 0.25); } .ds-item-card:active { transform: scale(0.985); } .ds-item-thumb { flex: none; width: 3.5rem; height: 3.5rem; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 0.6rem; background: var(--pa-green-soft, #e6f2ea); color: var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); } .ds-item-thumb.potted { background: var(--pa-clay-soft, #f6e6dc); color: var(--pa-clay, #b85c38); } .ds-item-thumb svg { width: 1.75rem; height: 1.75rem; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 1.75; } .ds-item-text { min-width: 0; } .ds-item-name, .ds-item-sub, .ds-item-meta { display: block; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-item-name { display: flex; align-items: center; font: 600 1.0625rem/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-item-name-text { overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; } .ds-item-name svg { flex: none; width: 0.9rem; height: 0.9rem; margin-left: 0.25rem; fill: var(--pa-clay, #b85c38); stroke: var(--pa-clay, #b85c38); stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-item-sub { font-style: italic; font-size: 0.875rem; color: var(--pa-muted, #5f6b63); } .ds-item-meta { margin-top: 0.15rem; font-size: 0.8rem; color: var(--pa-muted, #5f6b63); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Day Tile
components.description: How many days a propagation has been going, in its row's tile when there is no photo. With a photo, a small label sits in the photo's corner on a solid Leaf Tint patch instead.
components.css: .ds-day-thumb { width: 3.5rem; height: 3.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; align-items: center; border-radius: 0.6rem; background: var(--pa-green-soft, #e6f2ea); line-height: 1; color: var(--pa-green-dark, #1f5a37); } .ds-day-thumb b { font: 700 1.4rem/1 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; font-stretch: 80%; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -0.02em; } .ds-day-thumb small { margin-top: 0.1rem; font-size: 0.7rem; color: var(--pa-muted, #5f6b63); }

components.name: Settings Rows
components.description: Whole-row links to a page one level down, closed up into one bordered block divided by hairlines. Used on Settings, Supplies, the Help page and the dictionary. A row fills with Leaf Tint on hover instead of taking a green border.

components.css: .ds-rows { display: flex; flex-direction: column; overflow: hidden; background: var(--pa-surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--pa-border, #dde3dc); border-radius: 0.75rem; } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.85rem; padding: 0.7rem; border-top: 1px solid var(--pa-border, #dde3dc); color: var(--pa-text, #1d2520); text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 0.15s ease-out; } .ds-row:first-child { border-top: 0; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--pa-green-soft, #e6f2ea); } .ds-row:focus-visible { background: var(--pa-green-soft, #e6f2ea); outline: 2px solid var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); outline-offset: -2px; } .ds-row-text { flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; } .ds-row-text b { font: 600 1rem/1.4 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-row-text small { font: 400 0.8rem/1.4 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; color: var(--pa-muted, #5f6b63); } .ds-row svg { flex: none; width: 1.1rem; height: 1.1rem; color: var(--pa-muted, #5f6b63); fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; stroke-width: 2; }

components.name: Empty State
components.description: What a screen says before there is anything on it. Dashed so it reads as a placeholder, and it always says what to do next. The first-run version is Leaf Tint with a green dashed edge, a drawing and a Bricolage heading.
components.html: Nothing matches these filters.
components.css: .ds-empty { text-align: center; padding: 2.5rem 1rem; background: var(--pa-surface, #fff); color: var(--pa-muted, #5f6b63); border: 1px dashed var(--pa-border, #dde3dc); border-radius: 0.75rem; font: 400 1rem/1.5 system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; } .ds-empty p { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; } .ds-empty-btn { background: transparent; color: var(--pa-green-dark, #1f5a37); font: 600 1rem/1.5 'Bricolage Grotesque', system-ui, sans-serif; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; border: 1px solid var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); border-radius: 0.6rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-empty-btn:hover { background: var(--pa-green, #2f7d4f); color: #fff; } .ds-empty-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.2rem rgb(47 125 79 / 0.25); }

narrative.overview:
A potting bench is a working surface. Things are within reach, nothing is precious, and the person using it knows exactly what they are doing. The expertise shows in the labels and the dates, not in the decoration. Stikling should feel like that bench: warm, hands-on and unbothered, run by someone with soil under their fingernails who still knows precisely how many days that corm has been on the riser.

The tension that defines this system is warm and precise at the same time. The data is genuinely experimental, with mediums compared and days counted, but nothing about the interface should feel clinical or sterile. Numbers are rendered exactly and never decorated. Everything around them is soft, green and welcoming.

The first build was quieter than this target: white cards, thin grey borders, small muted labels, and one green used sparingly. The design refresh closed most of that gap with two changes the owner approved. Headings, names, counts and buttons now use a display typeface, Bricolage Grotesque, whose slightly handmade shapes and narrow widths recall the print on a nursery plant label. And clay, the colour of a terracotta pot, joined the green as a second material: green is what grows and what you can tap, clay is the pot a plant lives in. The one confirmed rejection still stands: no neon gradients over black, no glow shadows, no frosted glass.
keyCharacteristics: Phone first, one hand. On a wide screen the tabs become a side menu, and lists and plant pages use the width.
Two materials: green for growth and actions, clay for plants in pots, both against warm neutrals.
A display face for anything read at a glance: titles, names, day counts, buttons.
The days a propagation has been going are the biggest number on its row and its page.
Flat surfaces separated by tone and a hairline, not by shadow.
Stroked line icons throughout, never filled.
A full dark theme that is a real second skin, not a filter.
Exact values shown plainly: counts, days, stages, measurements.

rules.name: The Two Materials Rule
rules.body: Green means growing and acting: buttons, links, selection, stages, rooted counts. Clay means a plant in a pot, and nothing else. It never fills a button and never marks a state, with one exception: a favourite's star is filled Clay, because a favourite is about the plant itself, and green or red would read as a stage or a problem. Red means pests and danger. A fourth hue has no job to do.

rules.name: The Warm Neutral Rule
rules.body: No neutral in this system is a pure grey. Every one of them carries green. A `#f5f5f5` or a `#888` anywhere in this app is a bug, because it is the fastest way to turn the bench back into a clinic.

rules.name: The Two Greens Rule
rules.body: Potting Green fills, Deep Moss reads. Never set small text in Potting Green, and never fill a large area with Deep Moss.

rules.name: The Quiet Label Rule
rules.body: Section headings are small, uppercase and muted. They mark structure without competing with the content beneath them. They are never coloured, never large, and never heavier than 600.

rules.name: The Italic Species Rule
rules.body: Genus and species are set in italic wherever they appear. Cultivar names are not.

rules.name: The Glance Rule
rules.body: Bricolage is for things read at a glance, the system font for things read line by line. If a new element is a sentence, it is system font.

rules.name: The Thumb Rule
rules.body: On a phone, anything tapped often lives in the bottom third. The navigation, the add button and the action bars are all anchored there. The top of the screen is for reading, not for reaching. A wide screen is used with a mouse or held in two hands, so there the actions sit next to what they act on instead.

rules.name: The Safe Area Rule
rules.body: Any element fixed to the bottom adds `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)` to its own padding, and anything stacked above it offsets by the height of what it sits on. Nothing is allowed to hide under a home indicator.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. If a new component wants a shadow, the honest questions are whether it overlaps other content and whether it would still read in dark mode. If either answer is no, use tone and a hairline instead.

rules.name: The Tonal Depth Rule
rules.body: Warmth and depth are added by moving between Paper, Surface and Leaf Tint, not by adding shadows. This is the intended route out of the current restraint.

rules.name: The Stroked Icon Rule
rules.body: Every icon is a stroked outline with round caps, drawn inline as SVG and coloured with `currentColor`. No filled glyphs, no icon fonts, no two-tone icons.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Borders are 1px. A thicker border has to mean something specific, and these do: the 2px underline on an active tab, the 2px Potting Green edge of a picked tile (a pot in the picker, a photo that is shown on the public page), the 2px ring of a dot that sits on a photo or a track (a shelf dot, a sitter's visit), the 2px Ink rule under the title of a printed sheet, and the 2px focus outline. Tick boxes, badges and cards stay at 1px.

dos: Do use green for growth and actions, clay for plants in pots, and red for pests. Nothing else.
Do keep neutrals warm. Every grey in this app has green in it.
Do reach for Leaf Tint when a screen feels cold. Tonal surface is the intended route to warmth.
Do define both themes at once. A new colour without a dark counterpart is unfinished.
Do pad fixed bottom elements with `env(safe-area-inset-bottom)` and offset anything stacked above them.
Do truncate to one line in list rows so row height never varies.
Do set genus and species in italic.
Do use Bricolage for what is read at a glance and the system font for sentences.
Do draw icons as inline stroked SVG using `currentColor`.
Do show counts, days and stages as exact values.
donts: Don't use neon gradients over black, glow shadows or frosted glass. This is the one confirmed rejection.
Don't add a shadow to a resting surface. Use tone and a hairline.
Don't introduce a third font family or a fourth hue.
Don't fill a button or mark a state with clay. The favourite star is the one exception.
Don't set small text in Potting Green, or fill a large area with Deep Moss.
Don't use a pure grey anywhere.
Don't let a fixed element cover the last row of a list; lists reserve 5rem at the end.
Don't use filled icons or an icon font.
Don't load Bricolage from a CDN. It is self-hosted so the app works with no signal.
